summary_en: The study tests adding capivasertib to venetoclax and low-intensity chemotherapy (mini-hyperCVD) in adults with relapsed or refractory acute leukemia of lymphoid type or lymphoblastic lymphoma. Capivasertib is taken by mouth twice daily on a 4 days on, 3 days off schedule, venetoclax is taken by mouth once daily, and mini-hyperCVD is given in 8 cycles, about every 28 days. The study aims to assess the safety of this combination, and the record lists it as Phase 1/2.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa agregar capivasertib a venetoclax y a quimioterapia de baja intensidad (mini-hyperCVD) en adultos con leucemia aguda de tipo linfoide o linfoma linfoblástico recidivante o refractario. El capivasertib se toma por vía oral dos veces al día con un esquema de 4 días con tratamiento y 3 días sin él, el venetoclax se toma por vía oral una vez al día, y el mini-hyperCVD se administra en 8 ciclos, aproximadamente cada 28 días. El estudio busca evaluar la seguridad de esta combinación, y el registro indica que es de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory acute lymphoid leukemia or lymphoblastic lymphoma (cohorts 1 and 2).
At least 5% leukemic blasts in bone marrow or blood (cohorts 1 and 2).
Previously untreated patients aged 40 or older with at least 20% blasts (cohort 3).
Age 18 or older, with ECOG performance status 0-2.
Adequate organ function per protocol criteria.
not_for: Ph-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia or Burkitt leukemia/lymphoma.
Known active hepatitis B or C, or uncontrolled HIV.
